weapons.name: Bite
weapons.notes: Melee, 5 ft, piercing. On a hit the target makes a DC 11 Strength save or is knocked prone.

features.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
features.notes: Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

features.name: Pack Tactics
features.notes: Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the wolf's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.
